questions.question: Why was the LORD with King Jehoshaphat of Judah, the son of Asa?

answers.text: He walked in the earlier ways of King David
He brought gold back to the temple
He rebuilt the walls of Jerusalem

questions.question: Because King Jehoshaphat delighted in the ways of the LORD, what did he remove from Judah?

answers.text: The high places and Asherah poles
The golden calves of Bethel and Dan
The idols of Moab and Ammon

questions.question: When King Jehoshaphat sent officials, Levites and priests to teach the towns of Judah, what did they carry with them?

answers.text: The Book of the Law of the LORD

questions.question: The kingdoms around Judah made war against King Jehoshaphat. True or false?
